# llm-cluster-router

> OpenAI-compatible HTTP reverse-proxy for multi-node vLLM and Ollama clusters
> with fair-share per-user queuing. Drop-in proxy for `/v1/chat/completions`
> and `/v1/models` with streaming, tier-based routing, health checking, and
> Prometheus metrics.

## Overview

- Name: llm-cluster-router
- Purpose: OpenAI-compatible HTTP reverse-proxy for multi-node LLM clusters; provides fair-share per-user queuing, SSE streaming pass-through, tier-based routing (agent/fast/reasoning), health-checked upstreams with circuit breakers, Prometheus metrics, and SIGHUP config reload.
- Language(s): Go
- License: MIT
- Authoritative README: <https://github.com/nfsarch33/llm-cluster-router#readme>
- Source of truth branch: `main`

## Quick Start

- Install:
  ```
  go install github.com/nfsarch33/llm-cluster-router@latest
  ```
- Build from source:
  ```
  git clone https://github.com/nfsarch33/llm-cluster-router.git
  cd llm-cluster-router
  go build -o llm-cluster-router .
  ```
- Run with sample config:
  ```
  ./llm-cluster-router serve -config router.sample.yml
  ```
- Minimum runtime prerequisites: Go 1.22+

## Key Concepts

- Configuration via YAML (`router.sample.yml`): nodes, tiers, weights, auth, health check settings
- Endpoints: `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`, `/healthz`, `/metrics`
- Fair-share queuing: per-user sliding-window rate limiting prevents consumer starvation
- Tier-based routing: agent, fast, reasoning tiers with priority and weight
- Health checking: automatic probing with configurable thresholds for vLLM and Ollama backends
- Circuit breaker: 5-failure threshold, 30s cooldown per upstream
- SIGHUP reload: atomic config swap without dropping inflight requests
- Grafana dashboard: `dashboards/llm-cluster-router.json`
- Benchmark harness: `./llm-cluster-router bench` with TTFT p50/p95, throughput, cancellation probes
- GPU probing: `./llm-cluster-router probe-gpu` for NVIDIA inventory and VRAM usage

## Runnable Examples

- Run unit tests: `go test -race ./...`
- Run integration tests: `go test -tags=integration -timeout=2m -count=1 -race -v -run TestIT_ ./...`
- Benchmark: `./llm-cluster-router bench -url http://127.0.0.1:8080 -model <model-name> -requests 8 -concurrency 2`
- Reload config: `kill -HUP $(pgrep -f 'llm-cluster-router serve')`

## Operational Notes

- Issue tracker: <https://github.com/nfsarch33/llm-cluster-router/issues>
- Security: designed for self-hosted local GPU clusters only; do not point at corporate/managed AI gateways
- API keys support `${ENV_VAR}` expansion in config YAML
